an6.1:0.1: Namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa Aṅguttaranikāyo Chakkanipātapāḷi 1. Paṭhamapaṇṇāsakaṃ
an6.1:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an6.1:2.1: ‘‘Chahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
an6.1:2.3: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu cakkhunā rūpaṃ disvā neva sumano hoti na dummano, upekkhako viharati sato sampajāno.
an6.1:2.4: Sotena saddaṃ sutvā neva sumano hoti na dummano, upekkhako viharati sato sampajāno.
an6.1:2.5: Ghānena gandhaṃ ghāyitvā neva sumano hoti na dummano, upekkhako viharati sato sampajāno.
an6.1:2.6: Jivhāya rasaṃ sāyitvā neva sumano hoti na dummano, upekkhako viharati sato sampajāno.
an6.1:2.7: Kāyena phoṭṭhabbaṃ phusitvā neva sumano hoti na dummano, upekkhako viharati sato sampajāno.
an6.1:2.8: Manasā dhammaṃ viññā neva sumano hoti na dummano, upekkhako viharati sato sampajāno.
an6.1:2.9: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, chahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā’’ti.
an6.1:3.2: Attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
